name: Observation of Higgs boson production in association with a top quark pair

significance.quote: the observed significance is 5.8 standard deviations, compared to an expectation of 4.9 standard deviations

summary.plain: ATLAS observed Higgs bosons being produced together with a top quark and its antiparticle, which the paper describes as a more direct test of the Higgs boson's coupling to the top quark, the heaviest particle in the Standard Model.
summary.technical: ttH production searched for with Higgs decays into bb̄, WW*, τ⁺τ⁻, γγ and ZZ* in up to 79.8 fb⁻¹ of 13 TeV data: observed significance 5.8 standard deviations (4.9 expected). Combined with ttH searches in 4.5 fb⁻¹ at 7 TeV and 20.3 fb⁻¹ at 8 TeV: 6.3 (5.1) standard deviations. Total ttH cross section at 13 TeV: 670 ± 90 (stat) +110/−100 (syst) fb, in agreement with the Standard Model prediction.

title: Observation of Higgs boson production in association with a top quark pair at the LHC with the ATLAS detector
why_it_matters: The paper describes ttH production as a more direct test of the Higgs boson's coupling to the top quark than indirect measurements, which assume no contribution from unknown particles in the gluon-gluon fusion loop. The 13 TeV ttH cross section is measured as 670 ± 90 (stat) +110/−100 (syst) fb, in agreement with the Standard Model prediction.
